prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium illustrated banner for a private fashion and jewelry creative-work studio app, one of four matching menu banners. Primary request: an elegant tactile still-life illustration, matte sculpted paper mixed with soft ceramic and linen, editorial fashion art direction, delicate but clear silhouettes, calm natural window light, gentle realistic material shadows. Color palette: warm ivory #fffaf6, muted dusty rose #dcb8c0, soft sage #b9c9bc, deep mulberry #74475c, a few subdued champagne-metal accents. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, simple coherent group centered with all objects fully inside the frame and about 12% clear margin; enough breathing room to render at 220 to 420 CSS pixels wide. True transparent background, no rectangular backdrop, no floor line, no dark scene. Beautiful crafted editorial illustration, not cartoon emoji, not a dashboard screenshot. Text: none. Avoid all text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, people, robots, faces, checkmarks, approval seals, green lights, graphs, sparkles, confetti and cyber/network effects. This is a conceptual studio object illustration, not a real HAAR product image. Subject: a careful studio inspection scene: an ivory paper sheet with only abstract embossed layout shapes, a muted-rose magnifying glass placed beside it, a small raised ceramic display tile and a simple unbranded sculptural earring form resting on folded linen. Emphasize examining a draft and its details before approval; no checkmark or seal.
